name: Crescent Rock Arch — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Asymmetric apricot crescent rock arch with turquoise/opal fracture veins, pearl-like accents and sparse hanging gold star lanterns above the tide. Front and tiny isometric do not fully resolve the far foot/overhang geometry. Hidden layout inference: Use a shoreline approach to one small viewing ledge, an optional low tidal pass beneath the arch when geometry allows, and a return beach path. Keep its open crescent silhouette as hero; no castle wall or formal palace courtyard added. Put lights only at established attachment crevices. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B11-DETAIL-001 — Crescent Rock Arch — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need source-shaped arch footing/curve/crown sections and their hidden contact faces; use shared shoreline rocks, sand and waves. Opal veins/pearls/star pendants exist in image, so add isolated attachment views only where unclear. Salt plants/seabirds/crabs proposed; tide/navigation unverified. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
